// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// The other half of the same split. The vocabulary (@/lib/mailStatus) is pure
// and allowed; the recording half (@/lib/mailCounters) is Prisma-coupled and is
// not. This fixture is why the vocabulary was moved out of src/lib/ops/ rather
// than the mailer being dragged in: a file that imports an ops module is walked
// as ops code, and this one would fail for importing the client.
import { recordMailAttempt } from "@/lib/mailCounters";

export async function count() {
  return recordMailAttempt("magicLink", "accepted", 200);
}
